name: Tata Technologies Ltd
title: Tata Technologies Ltd - 544028 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 12.4% QoQ cc (8.8% organic) with EBITDA margin 16%; management guides double-digit FY27 cc growth and 18%+ exit margin, but no supply-side capex or capacity data disclosed.

triggers.label: FY27 double-digit cc growth reiterated
triggers.quote: we continue to expect double-digit organic top-line growth, excluding any inorganic contribution from ES-Tec

triggers.label: Full-vehicle programs: 2 closed, 2 more expected
triggers.quote: Two of these were closed during Q3 and Q4, and we expect at least another 2 to close over the next 8 to 12 weeks

triggers.label: Total DSO 111 → 95 days
triggers.quote: total DSO, both billed and unbilled, coming in at 95 days at the end of March, an improvement from the 111 days

triggers.label: Exit FY27 margin above 18%
triggers.quote: we expect to exit FY27 with an operating margin run rate that exceeds 18%

guidance.quote: we expected Q4 to deliver more than 10% sequential revenue growth alongside an operating margin exceeding 16%
we continue to expect double-digit organic top-line growth, excluding any inorganic contribution from ES-Tec
we expect to exit FY27 with an operating margin run rate that exceeds 18%

prior_guidance_check.quote: Q4 revenues grew by nearly 12% quarter -on-quarter in constant currency
our EBITDA margin for the quarter came in at 16%

red_flags.label: Q4 PBT boosted by one-time labour-code provision reversal
red_flags.quote: we reversed provisions amounting to INR 56 crores in Q4, resulting in a one -time exceptional gain for the quarter

red_flags.label: Middle East spillover could tighten customer discretionary spend
red_flags.quote: I fully expect discretionary spend amongst our customers to tighten if the Middle East crisis continues to extend

evasions.quote: we certainly saw JLR return to the normal run rate that we had before the cyber -attack
